mapper.update: UPDATE pay_order SET status = 'PAID', channel_trade_no = #{tradeNo}, paid_at = #{paidAt}, updated_at = #{paidAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'CREATED'

UPDATE pay_order SET status = 'PAID', channel_trade_no = #{tradeNo}, paid_at = #{paidAt}, updated_at = #{paidAt}, fail_reason = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'CLOSED'
UPDATE pay_order SET status = 'DELIVERED', updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'PAID'
UPDATE pay_order SET status = 'CLOSED', closed_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, fail_reason = #{reason}, version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'CREATED'
UPDATE pay_order SET status = 'CLOSED', closed_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, fail_reason = 'PAY_TIMEOUT', version = version + 1 WHERE status = 'CREATED' AND expires_at < #{now}

UPDATE pay_order SET refund_prev_status = status, status = 'REFUNDING', refund_no = #{refundNo}, refund_reason = #{reason}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status IN ('PAID', 'DELIVERED')
UPDATE pay_order SET status = 'REFUNDED', refund_no = #{refundNo}, refunded_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'REFUNDING'

UPDATE pay_order SET status = COALESCE(refund_prev_status, 'PAID'), refund_prev_status = NULL, refund_no = NULL, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'REFUNDING'
